svg.title: AxiomEngine packages
svg.desc: Go package imports reduced to direct arrows that are not implied by a longer chain. From cmd/server, HTTP packages lead through internal/server and internal/api to the reasoning service; MCP and the LLM adapter also import that service. The adapter imports baml_client. The API imports idempotency storage, and the service imports the graph and metrics. The transitive closure of these arrows equals the non-shared imports among the packages shown. The docs and test packages are excluded, along with generated baml_client support packages whose imports are represented by baml_client. The edge-less band contains config, telemetry and domain, which are imported throughout. Motion follows cmd/server to internal/server, internal/api, internal/service and internal/graph.
